statuses.gap: Application-facing API that the museum should demonstrate but does not yet; the backlog task that covers it is named.
statuses.supporting: Reached implicitly (exceptions, event arguments, option types, helper traits) by a demonstrated feature, or meaningful only inside a named gap.
statuses.not-applicable: Not application API for this museum (bootstrap, backend contracts, build-time internals); the reason is stated.

rules.reason: The museum has no C17 translation unit and links no CNA_C_API target, so none of the C ABI families (ABI version/result codes, handles, math, graphics, input, audio, content, net) is demonstrated.

Pure-virtual audio output/recording device contracts implemented by CNA's audio backends; applications reach audio only through SoundEffect/DynamicSoundEffectInstance/Microphone, which the audio rooms already use.
Game::Tick calls FrameworkDispatcher::Update itself (modules/runtime/src/Game.cpp), so every audio/media room exercises it implicitly; an explicit call only matters for non-Game hosts.
State enum of Microphone, which AudioLab already touches; real start/stop/BufferReady capture is the open gap M04.
Thrown only when no microphone is present; its demonstration belongs to the microphone refusal path of gap M04.
Error types of SoundEffect/SoundEffectInstance, which the audio rooms demonstrate; provoking them deterministically is part of M03/O06.
Defines only the CNAEXT documentation macro (or [[deprecated]] under CNA_STRICT_XNA_API); it has no runtime behaviour to show.
Base exception of CNA-specific failures; reached only when a CNAEXT call fails, which the exception room/O06 covers rather than a dedicated exhibit.
SetAssemblyTitleEXT/AssemblyTitleAttributeEXT (default window title, XNA AssemblyTitle counterpart) are never called by the museum.
hist-cna/pl-renderer show getGraphicsRendererMaturity but never getGraphicsRendererCategory/getCurrentGraphicsRendererCategory (Native/TranslationLayer/Software/Diagnostic).
No exhibit shows CNA::getCurrentPlatform()/isMobilePlatform() and the CNA_TARGET_* macros; missing a small platform-identity readout (pl-platform would fit).
CNA::getCurrentDesktopOS() (defined in modules/core/src/DesktopOS.cpp, throws off Desktop) is never called; missing together with the TargetPlatform readout.
CNA::Runtime/RuntimeOptions are declared but have no definition anywhere in CNA and no includer, so calling them would not link; it is a stale public export, not demonstrable API.
SetProjectGraphicsProfileEXT/ProjectGraphicsProfileEXT (the XNA project-level Reach/HiDef declaration) are never used; AppLab only switches profile via PreparingDeviceSettings.
GameWindow.TextDropEXT is not subscribed anywhere (only FileDropEXT is, in PlatformLab); G05 names TextDropEXT explicitly.
Event args of GameWindow.FileDropEXT, which pl-window claims and PlatformLab subscribes.
Args of Game.Exiting, which MuseumGame subscribes museum-wide (the event is logged at shutdown).
Used by src/Rendering/AssetPaths.cpp to resolve the content root beside TitleContainer, but no room claims it.
GraphicsDeviceInformation/PreparingDeviceSettingsEventArgs/IGraphicsDeviceManager are reached through GraphicsDeviceManager.PreparingDeviceSettings, which AppLab demonstrates.
CNA_DIAGNOSTICS_COUNTER_ADD/GAUGE_SET/FRAME_SCOPE macros are not used by the museum; their OFF/STATS/FULL behaviour is exactly O03.
Thrown when a StorageDevice disconnects; StorageDevice itself is used (Progress, ContentLab), the disconnect/error scenario is gap M06.
No exhibit serializes XNA math values through System::Xml::Serialization::XmlSerializer; missing an XmlSerializer round-trip exhibit (e.g. settings in a StorageContainer).
Keys enum XML registration is unused because the museum never uses XmlSerializer; same missing XmlSerializer exhibit as the math adapter.
CNA::Devices::Camera (enumerate/open/capture to Texture2D) is never used; PlatformLab only prints the camera capability flag.
Descriptor/enum types of CNA::Devices::Camera; meaningful only inside gap I04.

UrlLauncher::Open is never called; I03 asks for a controlled local test URL.

LocaleInfo/PowerState are the value types returned by Locale::getPreferredLocalesProperty/PowerInfo::getStateProperty, which cx-devices (CnaExtLab) reads.
Legacy WP7 7.0 Accelerometer.ReadingChanged event is still public but PhoneSensorLab only uses the SensorBase CurrentValueChanged pattern.
Args of Compass/Motion.Calibrate, which no room subscribes; calibration events are listed in gap I06.
ISensorReading base and SensorFailed/AccelerometerFailed exceptions of the sensors PhoneSensorLab demonstrates; failure paths belong to I06.
GameUpdateRequired/Network/NetworkNotAvailable exceptions surface only from failing async Guide/session calls, which gap N08 covers.

Event args and session-state enum of NetworkSession events (GamerJoined/Left, GameStarted/Ended), which NetLab subscribes.
Args of HttpNotificationChannel events; meaningful only inside gap N01.

VertexTypeRegistryEXT::Register/Resolve is never used; G01 is exactly this exhibit.

DisplayColorSpace and ShaderDialectEXT are the parameter/return types of SetDisplayColorSpaceEXT and GetShaderDialectEXT, which PlatformLab/CnaExtLab/TargetLab call.
DeviceLost/DeviceNotReset are only raised by a real device loss; their demonstration is gap G06.
Raised only when device creation fails at startup, before any room exists; at most an O06 error-path note.
Created internally by the content pipeline for every loaded model mesh part; games never instantiate it, and model rooms load such models.
Tangent-frame vertex layouts used by WireMesh and by skinned models drawn with SkinnedPbrEffect in ModelLab, but no room claims the structs.
HalfSingle is used in ValidationLab/PlatformLab without a claim; HalfTypeHelper is the conversion helper behind HalfSingle/HalfVector*.

Enums and collection types (BufferUsage, ClearOptions, FillMode, Effect*/Model*Collection, TextureCollection, DisplayModeCollection, IRenderTarget) are used implicitly by rooms that demonstrate buffers, clearing, rasterizer state, effect reflection, models and render targets.
Type of GameWindow.CurrentOrientation/SupportedOrientations, which pl-window claims.
Haptics::OpenEXT/HapticDevice (rumble, effect create/run/stop, gain/autocenter) is never used; InputLab only enumerates GetHapticsEXT.
Element type of Haptics::GetHapticsEXT, which in-devices enumerates.
Effect/feature/direction/capability types of HapticDevice; meaningful only inside gap I01.
Value types returned by Joysticks.GetJoysticksEXT/GetCapabilitiesEXT/GetStateEXT, which in-joystick claims.
Enums/records returned by demonstrated CNAEXT calls: GetButtonLabelEXT, GetConnectionStateEXT, GetPowerInfoEXT/Power::GetInfoEXT, GetModStateEXT and InputDevices.GetMiceEXT (InputLab).
GamePadButtons/DPad/ThumbSticks/Triggers/Type, KeyState and touch collection/capabilities are the members of states read by in-pad, in-keyboard and in-touch.
MediaLibrary, MediaSource and the album/artist/genre/playlist/picture classes are not referenced in museum src; enumeration with isolated fixture roots is M01/M02.
Chooses the compiled-in IPlatform implementation when the runtime starts; applications receive the result via Game::GetPlatformEXT, which pl-platform shows.
Ambient Set/Reset/Has hooks that let static XNA APIs and test harnesses find the installed platform; a game uses Game::GetPlatformEXT instead.
OpenGL context creation contract consumed by GL renderers, not by game code.
Present/scale contract between software-style renderers and the window; game code never presents through it.
Creation-time window attributes (render intent, fullscreen mode) the runtime passes when it creates the game window.
Raw event stream pumped by Game and translated into XNA/CNAEXT events (window, input, drop, device), which the rooms observe at that level.
Discriminator inside NativeWindowHandle, which pl-window claims (GameWindow.GetNativeWindowHandleEXT); PlatformLab includes the header.
Enum twin of the PlatformCapabilities struct that pl-platform reads.
Thrown by failing platform operations behind CNAEXT facades; an error-path topic of O06.
Platform SPI behind CNA::Devices::Camera; meaningful only inside gap I04.
Platform SPI behind CNA::Input::Haptics/HapticDevice; the device side is gap I01.

Platform contracts and key enums behind Keyboard/Mouse/GamePad/Joysticks/Sensors/TextInputEXT; pl-platform reaches IPlatform::GetKeyboard etc. and the input rooms demonstrate the facades.
IPlatformWindow/IPlatformSystemServices sit behind GameWindow, Clipboard and cx-devices facades the museum demonstrates; dialogs/tray/URL parts belong to gaps I02/I03.

Overflow-checked offset helpers for CNB readers; meaningful only inside the custom-loader gap C07.
